notes.title: Development Update!
notes.notes:
First off, thank you to everyone that has wishlisted Spiral of Regret - we didn't expect to get so many in such a short space of time!

Secondly, the final development cycle of the game is well underway and we are in the process of finalising features and ending out the gameplay loop.

We're very excited to show you more of our first game so stay tuned for more updates!
